project_info.theme: Dark grunge fashion portrait in an illustrated collage
project_info.creative_direction: High-fashion portrait integrated with monochrome collage fragments and a soft white outline glow
project_info.color_palette: charcoal black, off-white, muted gray, light beige, and restrained black-and-white collage tones

main_subject.detail: stylish adult woman with voluminous natural curly hair, calm direct gaze, one hand resting against her face, and the other hand in a pocket
main_subject.wardrobe: loose black button-up shirt and light beige trousers
main_subject.pose: relaxed standing fashion pose with a self-possessed expression

composition_elements.framing: vertical centered portrait with the model dominating the foreground
composition_elements.background: artistic black-and-gray collage with a vintage police-car illustration, flying Pegasus, perfume bottle, newspaper fragments, record label, and abstract paint textures
composition_elements.graphic_treatment: soft white outline glow separating the adult subject from the collage, layered paper edges and distressed ink marks
composition_elements.typography: use only abstract or illegible fictional newspaper texture; no real names, logos, or official insignia

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: large soft key at approximately 4800K with low frontal fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: gentle facial modeling, textured black fabric, subdued collage contrast, and a luminous white edge treatment

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame editorial camera with 50mm lens, photoreal fashion portrait composited with printed collage textures
technical_specs.finish: visible paper grain, natural skin texture, slight optical falloff, restrained saturation, and crisp fabric detail

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A stylish clearly adult woman poses with one hand on her face and the other in her pocket, wearing a loose black shirt and light beige pants. She has voluminous curly hair and stands against an artistic black-and-gray collage background. The collage includes a vintage police-car illustration, a flying Pegasus, a perfume bottle, newspaper fragments, a record label, and abstract paint textures. Create a dark grunge mood with a soft white outline glow around the person, high-fashion photography styling, realistic textures, visible paper grain, and natural skin detail. Use a 50mm editorial lens, soft approximately 4800K key light, and a vertical social portrait composition. Keep all collage marks fictional and non-official, with no real logos or identifying text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, real police insignia, real logos, readable personal data, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, broken collage layers

changes: Clarified the source's young woman as a clearly adult woman and constrained the collage's police imagery and text to fictional non-official graphics while preserving the dark grunge fashion concept.
